snippet.title: 7Trials - 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist '7Trials' on Steam right now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4192680/7_Trials/

A stylish action roguelite in a twisted afterlife. Contracted by an underworld corporation, explore regions consumed by the liminal realm and guide lost souls to judgment. Combine Spells, Offerings, and Fates to forge your own combat build; face deeper challenges in 4-player co-op.

#7Trials #actionroguelite #indiegame
